title: Partners-gui
body:
The Partners GUI is a system that allows players to open a menu using the /partners command. In this menu, players can click on their favorite YouTuber to vote for them and receive a special reward.(y)


The entire system is fully configurable: you can add or remove partners, change icons, and customize the rewards as you wish. Additionally, the interface and messages are completely translatable so you can adapt it to your preferred language.

To define the reward the player receives, you simply configure the command in English that will be executed when the player votes for a partner. This gives you the flexibility to make the reward anything supported by commands on your server (items, effects, money, etc.).

COMMANDS:
- /partners
- /partners reload (Need permission)
Permission: apoyar.reload.true
